taskContracts.objective: Define P69 release/deploy contracts and disabled execution boundary.

inputs.narrowScope: Define release/deploy loop contracts only; no release or deploy execution behavior.
safetyRules: Do not enable release execution, deploy execution, project mutation, provider dispatch, tool execution, worker execution, DB writes, external network calls, or provider spend.
Release and deploy records must be preview-only, approval-aware, rollback-aware, evidence-linked, and non-executing.
Primary UX must not expose raw JSON, raw logs, raw private project IDs, fake runnable release/deploy actions, internal phase labels outside OS Roadmap, or DemoApp outside demo mode.

reuseCheck.rule: Reuse existing result, report, mode guard, phase status, Command Center, evidence, activity, and controlled implementation patterns; do not duplicate helpers.

uxUpdate.scope: No Command Center page behavior changes in P69.1.
uxUpdate.required: Future UX must show release state, deploy state, next action, blockers, disabled reason, owner capability, evidence/activity location, rollback posture, and cost impact.

dataShapes: releaseId, targetKind, environmentLabel, allowedFiles, forbiddenFiles, releaseExecutionAllowed, deployExecutionAllowed, approvalRequired, rollbackPlan, disabledReason, blockers, evidenceRefs, activityRefs, costImpact, nextAction

inputs.commandCenterUxRequirements: Command Center UX must show current state, next action, blockers, disabled reason, owner capability, evidence/activity location, rollback posture, and cost impact without raw JSON, raw logs, raw private IDs, DemoApp leakage, internal phase labels, or fake runnable release/deploy actions.
playwrightTests: No new Playwright route is required in P69.1 because no UX route changes are made.
Future P69 UX must cover disabled release/deploy actions, themes, no raw dumps, no DemoApp leakage, and sidebar navigation.
testsCheckers: Keep backend/kernel behavior covered by checker scripts.

inputs.phaseStatusUpdate: Mark P69 in_progress, mark P69.1 complete after validation, and set nextPhase to P69.2.
finalSafetyChecks: Confirm release execution, deploy execution, project mutation, provider dispatch, tool execution, worker execution, DB writes, network calls, and provider spend were not enabled.
